summary: Lolo NF tower in Flathead County: 50-ft L-4 dated 1940, destroyed 1962, listed as gone; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Destroyed 1962 according to firelookout.com; the Montana list also marks the tower gone

events.note: Listed for 1940 as a 50-foot L-4 tower; the listing does not use the word built

evidence.supports: coordinates 47.95586 north, 114.87630 west; type Tower; status Gone
destroyed 1962 on the same page as the 1940 date

notes_for_editor: Only two brief listings were found (firelookout.com and the Montana list), and the two agree. The 1940 date is the listing's date for the tower, not a confirmed build year. Do not confuse this with the Lolo Peak lookout, a different site whose L-4 tower is recorded as destroyed in 1963. Record elevation_m is still null; firelookout.com gives 6,410 ft (about 1,954 m). The brief's agency is filled from the page. No staffing, fire, access or photo information was found.
